question: Should OpenClaw stabilize `currentTokenCount` plus the token-budget helper exports as the narrow public ContextEngine/plugin SDK contract now, or defer this signal into the broader #82137 assemble-metadata design?
rationale: The code path is plausible, but this is a public plugin SDK/API decision that affects external context-engine authors and overlaps a broader open RFC, so automation should not choose the permanent contract shape alone.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Gates
options.body: Approve this optional token-headroom field now, then require the SDK baseline update and real long-session proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into #82137
options.body: Pause or close this PR and design token headroom together with provenance/internal-event assemble metadata in the broader RFC.

options.title: Keep Internal Only
options.body: Reject the SDK export expansion and keep any token-budget helpers internal until a wider plugin API contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Gates
recommendation.body: Approve this optional token-headroom field now, then require the SDK baseline update and real long-session proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current rebase, merged adjacent budgeting work, and have the clearest recent ownership signal for the context-engine budget/API surface.
